verdict.rationale: A project instructions or conventions file is a fair question for a coding agent like Aider, but the evidence pack never documents one. The .aider.conf.yml file only sets command-line options, and the --watch-files feature reacts to inline AI comments; neither is a standing coding-standards file the agent follows. With no direct evidence, the verdict is none.

support.subject: As a developer, I can add a project instructions file to set coding standards and conventions the agent follows
